prayerExcerpt.en-US: The just shall live for evermore; they shall receive a kingdom of glory, and a crown of beauty at the hand of the Lord.
prayerExcerpt.pt-BR: Os justos viverão para sempre; receberão um reino de glória e uma coroa de beleza da mão do Senhor.

meta.face: A Frank of about thirty-five, CLEAN-SHAVEN, with a fair, fresh complexion and an INVERTED-TRIANGLE face with a CLEFT chin — a WIDE, HIGH, smooth forehead and broad temples narrowing along a lean, straight jaw to a NARROW chin marked by a clear CLEFT; a thin, straight nose with a narrow bridge; DEEP-SET, pale-blue eyes under straight, fair brows; flat, lean cheeks; a thin, WIDE mouth; ash-blond hair cut SHORT round a monastic tonsure, the long royal locks gone; the gaze level, clear and resolved. Not the pale, jaw-heavy young louis_toulouse, nor the lean, long-faced grandmother clotilda.
meta.basis: No likeness survives; a modern statue (Wikipedia's lead) gives him a chalice. The Martyrology and Wikipedia tell the royal Merovingian boy who escaped his uncles and renounced the throne to become a cleric, and Frankish long hair was the sign of royalty, so the card shows him cropped and tonsured with the crown set aside; the face is ours.
